nosclient.mod.coords.perf: Reads position and biome straight from the game; the biome is re-translated only when it changes.
nosclient.mod.direction.perf: Computed from your view angle; never re-reads the world.
nosclient.mod.day.perf: Reads the world time, nothing else.
nosclient.mod.fps.perf: Uses the game's own FPS counter; 1% low comes from recent frame times.
nosclient.mod.ping.perf: Uses the ping the server reports in the player list.
nosclient.mod.cps.perf: Stores each click time in a ring buffer, dropping ones older than 1 s.
nosclient.mod.effects.perf: Reads the player's active effects; the game's own list is hidden.
nosclient.mod.invhud.perf: Draws the inventory slots directly, no copying.
nosclient.mod.recipe.perf: Opens the game's own recipe book when you open your inventory.
nosclient.mod.shulker.perf: Reads item data directly, only while hovering.
nosclient.mod.mappv.perf: Uses map data the game already has, only while hovering.
nosclient.mod.armor.perf: Reads durability of your 4 armor pieces and held item.
nosclient.mod.waypoint.perf: Saved per server IP (or world name) and dimension.
nosclient.mod.minimap.perf: Reads only the surface heightmap, so no caves; draws each chunk once when it loads and remembers where you've been (saved to config/nosclient-map).
nosclient.mod.blockinfo.perf: Checks what you're looking at every 10 ticks.
nosclient.mod.zoom.perf: Only changes the camera's field of view.
nosclient.mod.light.perf: Glowing held items light nearby blocks; only re-renders when the light moves. Gamma is written to the game's brightness setting.
nosclient.mod.keys.perf: Reads the game's own key state; no extra input thread.
nosclient.mod.sprint.perf: Same as holding sprint: the game sends the usual packets.
nosclient.mod.freelook.perf: Detaches the camera from your facing; nothing sent to the server changes.
nosclient.mod.dfps.perf: Lowers the game's frame limit when the window is in the background, minimized or AFK.
nosclient.mod.mp.perf: Uses the game's built-in LAN server; turns off login checks so offline accounts can join.
nosclient.intro.opt.desc: A tree grows into the logo, once per game start. Press any key to skip.
